relations: The clock hands, if time advances, rotate clockwise about the central pivot while the dial remains fixed to the wall.
The glossy pebbles resting on the textured surface tend to stay at rest unless disturbed by contact or vibration.
Reflected light on the wet-looking pebble surfaces persists as the pile remains positioned in front of the clock.
The red second hand, if moving, sweeps the outer ring without altering the pebble arrangement.
